units.source_text: 这大规模的筹备，轰动全国，式部卿亲王也闻知了。

en.t: These large scale preparations stirred the whole country, and Prince Shikibukyo also heard about them.

units.source_text: 他想：“近年来源氏对世人普遍照拂，惟有对我家漠不关心，万事冷酷无情。

en.t: He thought, In recent years Genji has shown broad kindness to people everywhere, but toward my family alone he has been indifferent, cold, and heartless in everything.

units.source_text: 对于我的下属，也都毫无恩惠。

en.t: Even toward my retainers, he has shown no favor at all.

units.source_text: 想是为了他流寓须磨时我不曾寄予同情，因而怀恨于我吧。”

en.t: Perhaps he bears a grudge against me because I showed him no sympathy when he was living in exile at Suma.

units.source_text: 他觉得抱歉，又觉得可恨。

en.t: He felt sorry about it, yet also felt resentful.

units.source_text: 但念源氏在许多妻妾之中，特别宠爱他的女儿，使他享受令人妒羡的幸运，他家虽未直接受到恩惠，也觉很有面子。

en.t: But when he considered that, among his many wives and consorts, Genji especially loved his daughter and had given him a fortune others could only envy, he felt that even if his house had received no direct favor, it had still gained great honor.

units.source_text: 现在为了替他祝寿，又如此盛大排场，轰动全国，真是晚年意外的荣幸，他心中十分欢喜。

en.t: Now, with such splendid arrangements being made to celebrate his long life, enough to stir the whole country, it was truly an unexpected honor in his old age, and he was deeply pleased.

units.source_text: 但他的夫人只管心怀怨恨，闷闷不乐。

en.t: But his wife simply nursed her resentment and remained gloomy and unhappy.

units.source_text: 想是为了她的亲生女儿当年想入宫当女御，

en.t: It was probably because her own daughter had once hoped to enter the palace and become an imperial consort,

units.source_text: 而源氏未予提拔，因而更增怨恨吧。

en.t: but Genji had not promoted her, and this must have deepened her resentment still further.
